user.title: Kitty Controller Setup
user.description: Enter the API address and token for your Kitty instance. Examples: 192.168.1.1:9090, kitty.mydomain.com. If the location is an IP address, make sure it's static.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Kitty Connection
reconfigure.description: Please update the connection settings or credentials for this Kitty instance.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the API. Verify the address and try again.
error.invalid_token: The provided API token is invalid. Please check and try again.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
error.timed_out: API connection timed out. Is Kitty running?

abort.already_configured: The instance at this location is already added. Use configure button to update token and modify settings.

init.title: Kitty Controller Options
init.description: Modify options of this entry. To detect streaming service availability, Home Assistant must connect through the same proxy being tested.

data.bearer_token: Update Bearer Token (Leave empty to skip)
data.default_groups: Extra groups enabled by default (keywords, comma-separated)

error.invalid_token: The provided API token is invalid. Please check and try again.

reboot_core_service.name: Reboot Kitty Core
reboot_core_service.description: Reboot the core of the remote Kitty instance.

filter_connection_service.name: Filter Connection
filter_connection_service.description: Retrieve and optionally close active connections using keyword filters. Separate multiple keywords with comma ",". Keywords are case-insensitive.

close_connection.name: Close Connection
close_connection.description: If enabled, retrieved connections will also be closed

get_latency_service.name: Get Latency
get_latency_service.description: Get the latency of a specified node or group. Only one field should be provided at a time. A 504 error may occur if the URL is misconfigured or the request times out.

group.name: Group Name
group.description: The proxy group name. Testing a group will also clear its fixed option if set

url.name: URL
url.description: The URL used to test the latency

dns_query_service.name: DNS Query
dns_query_service.description: Perform a DNS query with Kitty.

record_type.name: Record Type
record_type.description: The record type to query. Leave empty to get IPv4 (A) record

api_call_service.name: API Call
api_call_service.description: Perform a general API call to Kitty and optionally retrieve response.

api_endpoint.name: Endpoint
api_endpoint.description: The API endpoint to be used

api_params.name: Parameters
api_params.description: The query parameters for the request. Needs to be a valid json string

api_data.name: Payload
api_data.description: The json body sent in the request. Needs to be a valid json string

update_rule_provider_service.name: Update Rule Provider
update_rule_provider_service.description: Trigger the specified rule provider to re-fetch its subscription (PUT /providers/rules/{name}).

update_proxy_provider_service.name: Update Proxy Provider
update_proxy_provider_service.description: Trigger the specified proxy provider to re-fetch its subscription (PUT /providers/proxies/{name}).

healthcheck_provider_service.name: Healthcheck Proxy Provider
healthcheck_provider_service.description: Trigger a health check for all nodes of the specified proxy provider and return each node's alive state and latest latency.

provider_name.name: Proxy Provider Name
provider_name.description: The proxy provider to test, using its own configured test URL

upgrade_core.name: Upgrade Core
upgrade_core.description: Core upgrade started, Kitty will restart briefly
